findings.description: Any logged-in attendee can call tickets.comp and issue free tickets (price 0) to any holder, up to 50 per request. Other privileged routes (event.cancel, event.attendees) use require_role. This lets any user bypass payment entirely.
findings.suggestion: Call require_role(request.user, Role.STAFF, Role.ADMIN) and use the returned user for issued_by.
findings.title: comp_tickets only requires login, not a staff/admin role
